files.file: added list_logs(conn): ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC; photos fetched in one query ordered by position, id
added GET /logs (response_model list[LogOut], threadpool, 500 on error); POST timestamp now isoformat(timespec="microseconds")
added 6 tests: empty, order/shape/photos, tie-break, timestamp-not-id order, photo position order, client created_at ignored

commands_run.command: cd backend; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q tests

design_decisions.decision: POST already ignores unknown form fields; kept that and only tested it (form field, file part, query param). Rejected adding rejection logic.
Fixed microsecond timespec on server timestamp so isoformat never drops the fraction; rejected leaving default, which gives mixed string formats.
Photos fetched in one query and grouped in Python; rejected per-log queries (N+1).

implementation.self_critique: Timespec change alters the POST timestamp format only when microsecond==0 (negligible). Photo-order test shuffles photo ids rather than positions, so position ordering is covered weakly.
